The Essentials

What to Include (The List)

Before you build, here is the cheat-sheet of what every great pet sitter needs to know to keep your pet safe.

warning

Triggers & Fears

Does your dog hate thunder? Do they lunge at skateboards? Are they scared of men in hats? Be honest about reactivity.
medical_services

Medical & Allergies

List all medications with times. Crucially, mention food allergies or if they are prone to eating things off the ground (pica).
home

House Rules

Allowed on the couch? Do they sleep in a crate? Are they an escape artist who dashes out doors? Set expectations.
